extraction: VizieR ASU TSV export, -out=**&-out.max=unlimited. Cleaned file maps upstream columns to a standard schema (id,ra_deg,dec_deg,z,z_err,q_flag,member_flag) and appends sep_arcmin and R_proj_Mpc computed from the cluster centre with FlatLambdaCDM(H0=70,Om0=0.3). No rows dropped. Where the upstream redshift is stored as a velocity cz in km/s it is converted to z=cz/c and its uncertainty is converted consistently to dz=e_cz/c; otherwise no values are altered. Raw upstream response kept verbatim in raw/.
note: Abell 2744 (z=0.308). Owers, Randall, Nulsen, Couch, David & Kempner 2011, ApJ 728, 27 ('The dissection of Abell 2744'), table 5 'Combined redshift catalog'. 1509 rows. IMPORTANT COMPOSITION: 259 of the 1509 rows are stars/foreground objects with cz<3000 km/s and these are exactly the rows with quality flag q_cz=6; the remaining 1250 rows are extragalactic. This reconciles with the published statement of 1237 extragalactic redshifts within 15 arcmin (the extra ~13 lie just outside 15 arcmin). The paper identifies 343 cluster members; there is NO membership column in the VizieR table, so members must be re-derived downstream. An indicative |dv|<3000 km/s rest-frame cut gives 418 galaxies - larger than the published 343 because Owers et al. applied additional substructure-aware selection. Instrument: AAOmega on the 3.9 m Anglo-Australian Telescope (2006 Sep 12-16), plus literature redshifts from Couch & Sharples, Boschin+2006 and Braglia+2009 (column r_cz gives the source, so this catalogue is a heterogeneous COMPILATION, not a single homogeneous survey). Selection function: targets drawn from the SuperCOSMOS Sky Survey photometric catalogue, r_F band; magnitudes span 16.5-23.0, no colour preselection stated. Quality flag q_cz runs 3-6 (3=lowest usable, 6=star). Sky coverage: to ~15.3 arcmin (~4.2 Mpc projected); 90% within ~3.8 Mpc. This is the widest-field spectroscopy available for A2744.
